nonjoinder.definition:
n. The omission of some person who ought to have been made
   a plaintiff or defendant in a suit, or of some cause of action which
   ought to be joined.
nonjoinder.translation:
n. 未参加诉讼
[法] 非共同诉讼

nonjudgmental.definition: a. refraining from making judgments especially ones based on personal opinions or standards
nonjudgmental.translation: a. 不按个人道德标准进行评定的, 不偏不倚的, 客观的

nonjurant.translation:
n. 不愿宣誓的人, 拒誓者
a. 不愿宣誓的

nonjuring.definition:
a. Not swearing allegiance; -- applied to the party in
   Great Britain that would not swear allegiance to William and Mary, or
   their successors.

nonjuror.definition:
n. One of those adherents of James II. who refused to take
   the oath of allegiance to William and Mary, or to their successors,
   after the revolution of 1688; a Jacobite.

nonjurors.definition:
plural of nonjuror
n. One of those adherents of James II. who refused to take
   the oath of allegiance to William and Mary, or to their successors,
   after the revolution of 1688; a Jacobite.
nonjurors.translation: (nonjuror 的复数) n.不肯宣誓效忠者

nonjury.translation: adj. 无陪审团的; 无陪审团审判的
